title: Story premise ENT097: The Plant-Watering Calendar Duel
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (everyday microdramas). Hook: We both remembered. That is the problem. Takeaway/theme: Make a shared task’s status visible to both people.
description: Two roommates each think the other forgot to water a decorative paper plant and add blue paper droplets to its pot. The absurd droplet pile reveals the duplicated effort; they put one reversible DONE card beside the pot and take turns flipping it as part of a pretend care routine.
